description: This Java class 'CustomizedGlobalEventRegistry' extends 'AbstractJsonParsableRegistry' and implements 'EventRegistry'. It manages event parsing strategies by merging global event types with custom strategies, allowing for adding or replacing parse strategies in the context of event handling within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: CustomizedGlobalEventRegistry
classes.description: A registry class that manages event parse strategies by integrating global event types with custom strategies for flexible event parsing.

methods.name: mergeParseStrategy
methods.description: Static method that merges global event types with custom parse strategies into a single map.

methods.name: resolveType
methods.description: Overrides method to resolve the type of an event based on the provided JsonObject, delegating to the global event registry.

methods.name: CustomizedGlobalEventRegistry (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the registry with a global event registry and custom parse strategies, merging them into a combined parse strategy map.
